terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The terms for using emigisha.com and the apps run by Emigisha, LLC.
terms.intro: These terms cover emigisha.com and the apps run by Emigisha, LLC: Talatala, StyledDoc, PrettyCV and any other app that links to these terms. When you create an account or use one of these apps, you agree to them.

who.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Emigisha, LLC ("Emigisha", "we") is a Delaware limited liability company.
An app may add its own rules on its site, such as how its credits work. For that app, those rules apply on top of these terms.

account.title: Your account
paragraphs: You must be 18 or older. Give accurate details, keep your password safe, and tell us if someone else gets into your account. You are responsible for what happens in it.

content.title: Your content
paragraphs: What you upload stays yours. You let us store and process it only to run the app for you.
Only upload content you have the right to use. If it shows another person, you must have their explicit consent.

notAllowed.title: What you may not do
items: Break the law, or use our apps to harm someone
Upload content that is not yours to use
Impersonate anyone, or make misleading images of real people
Try to break, overload or get around the security of our apps
Scrape, copy or resell our apps or what they produce at scale

ai.title: AI results
paragraphs: Our apps use AI. Results can be wrong or unexpected. Check them before you rely on them or share them, especially CVs, documents and photos of people.

payments.title: Payments
paragraphs: Prices are shown before you pay, in the currency shown at checkout. We take card payments through Stripe and mobile money through pawaPay. Credits expire as each app states.
Refunds follow our Refund Policy at emigisha.com/refunds.

availability.title: Changes and availability
paragraphs: We improve our apps often, and may change or stop a feature or an app. If we stop a paid app, we refund unused credits.
We do our best to keep things running, but the apps are provided "as is", without warranties of any kind.

liability.title: Liability
paragraphs: We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, such as lost profits or lost data. Our total liability is limited to the greater of what you paid us in the 12 months before the claim or US$100.
Nothing in these terms limits liability that the law does not allow us to limit.

ending.title: Ending
paragraphs: You can stop using an app and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms or puts the apps or other people at risk.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: If we make an important change, we tell you by email or in the app before it applies.

law.title: Law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, and disputes go to the courts of Delaware. This does not take away any consumer protection the law of your country gives you.

contact.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these terms: {legalEmail}.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What Emigisha, LLC collects in its apps, why, who helps us, and how to delete it.
privacy.intro: Emigisha, LLC runs Talatala, StyledDoc, PrettyCV and the other apps that link to this policy. It explains what we collect, why, who helps us, and how to have your data deleted.

collect.title: What we collect
items: Account details: your name, your email, and your phone number if you give it
What you put in the app: photos, CV details, documents, and the results we make from them
Payment records: the amount, date and status of each payment. We never see your card number or mobile money PIN; Stripe and pawaPay handle payment details
Support messages, and basic technical logs (device, browser, IP address) used to keep the apps secure

why.title: Why we use it
paragraphs: To run the app you use, take payments, keep accounts secure, answer support, and meet our legal and tax duties. We do not sell your data and do not use it for ads.

processors.title: Who helps us
paragraphs: These services process data for us, each only for the job listed. Some of them process data in the United States and other countries.
items: Railway: hosting the apps and their databases (all apps)
Cloudflare: storing files, checking that sign-ups come from people, and counting visits without cookies (all apps)
pawaPay: mobile money payments (Talatala, and PrettyCV once it launches)
ZeptoMail: sending emails such as confirmation links (all apps)
fal.ai: making photos from your selfies (Talatala)
Anthropic: answering chat messages (StyledDoc, and PrettyCV once its chat ships)

retention.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your data while your account is open. Payment records are kept as long as tax rules require, and technical logs for a short time.
When you delete your account, we delete your content and personal data within 30 days, except what the law requires us to keep.

delete-account.title: Delete your account
paragraphs: Use Delete account in the app's settings. If you cannot sign in, email {supportEmail} from the address on your account and name the app.

rights.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask to see, correct, export or delete your data, or object to how we use it. Write to {supportEmail} and we reply within 30 days. You can also complain to the data protection authority in your country.

children.title: Children
paragraphs: Our apps are not for anyone under 18, and we do not knowingly collect data from children.

cookies.title: Cookies
paragraphs: We only use the cookies needed to keep you signed in. Our visit counts do not use cookies, and we use no advertising trackers.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we change this policy in an important way, we tell you by email or in the app before it applies.

contact.title: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about your data: {supportEmail}.
